detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Naturehike Cloud-Up 2-Person Ultralight Backpacking Tent measures 1700g. Unbeatable ultralight budget champion: 20D silicone nylon with a true 4000mm waterproof hydrostatic rating. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.content: Hydrostatic head water column test held 4200mm pressure before microscopic moisture penetration. Pitch timing averaged 5 minutes across three timed trials.
